name: Zenith Mace Impact
name_jp: 究極メイスインパクト
effects:
7 single-target Earth/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Lv.3 En-Earth, En-Earth Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user

Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
